title: All wines and spirits
description: Every bottle we bring in: Bordeaux, Burgundy and the Loire, Napa and Sonoma, the Dão, and grappa and amaro from Italy.

title: Red wines
description: From a twenty-dollar Dão to Pomerol made in new barrels. Choose by taste, not by grape.

title: White wines
description: Chablis, Graves, Touraine and Napa Chardonnay. Whites for the first course and the long summer table.

title: Grappa, amaro and liqueur
description: Aged grappa from Trentino and the Veneto, amaro, and one very good tiramisù liqueur.

title: Limited allocations
description: Small-production wines and spirits we receive by the case, not the pallet. When they are gone, they are gone.

title: Bordeaux
description: Pessac-Léognan, Margaux, Saint-Émilion, Pomerol and Fronsac, from estates that have been in the same families for generations.

title: Burgundy
description: Chablis on fossil-rich Kimmeridgian limestone, and Pinot Noir from Pommard.

title: Loire Valley
description: Sauvignon on flint in Touraine: lively, fresh and aromatic.

title: California
description: Napa Valley Cabernet, Syrah and Malbec, and Alexander Valley Zinfandel from family wineries.

title: Portugal
description: Touriga Nacional and friends from the granite hills of the Dão.

title: Italy
description: Grappa from Trentino and the Veneto, and amaro made the old monks' way.
